title.rendered: Elevate Your Network Visibility with ntop Professional Training November 2026

content.rendered:
As network architectures evolve, staying ahead of performance issues and modern cybersecurity threats requires deep visibility and mastery of your tools. Here at ntop, our product range spans from high-speed packet capture to advanced traffic analysis. With our continuous updates and feature additions, keeping up with the ecosystem can be a challenge. Whether you are configuring large enterprise installations or looking to minimize the learning curve for new team members, this structured training will equip you with everything you need to build a tailored monitoring infrastructure.

What’s New? Mastering ntopng 7.0

Led directly by the creators of the software, the training covers core competencies and advanced deployment strategies, this training cycle is uniquely designed to cover our latest product releases, featuring a deep dive into the ground-breaking ntopng 7.0. You will get hands-on guidance on how to leverage:

  • nAnalyst AI: Learn how to utilize our new AI-assisted layer for rapid traffic and security analysis.
  • ClickHouse Timeseries: Master the rebuilt, ultra-fast data engine backend.
  • Advanced Routing Visibility: Harness new BGP, BMP, and OT observability features.
  • Modernized GUI: Navigate the completely rebuilt, intuitive user frontend.
Course Schedule & Logistics

To make it easy to participate without disrupting your daily work responsibilities, the course is split into bite-sized, highly interactive digital sessions.

  • Time: 3:00 PM CET / 9:00 AM EDT
  • Dates: November 10th, 12th, 17th, 19th, 24th, and 26th.
  • Format: Online via Microsoft Teams
  • Language: English
  • Structure: 5 sessions of 90 minutes each
Registration Perks & Certification
  • Complimentary Pro License: Every registered attendee will receive a license of ntopng Pro to continue practicing and improving their skills long after the webinars end.
  • On-Demand Recordings: Can’t make a specific time slot? All registrants get full access to the session recordings.
  • Certificate of Proficiency: Attendees can opt to take an official exam evaluated by the ntop team to earn a formal Certificate of Proficiency.
Reserve Your Seat

Spaces are limited to ensure an optimal environment for open discussion and Q&A.

 Click Here to Book Your Seat and secure your spot today.

Have questions about team discounts or custom installations? Feel free to contact our team directly at training@ntop.org.
